status: PROPOSED - art suggestion, nothing wired in-engine
sheet_layout: horizontal strip, frames left->right, frame_size each

wheat_young_sway.anchor: bottom-centre (same anchor as props/wheat_young.png; frame is 12 px (2x) / 6 px (1x) wider on each side so tops never clip)
wheat_young_sway.note: Crosshaven grass sway method: 16 f @ 8 fps (2 s loop), per-plant phase offsets, bend grows with height above the soil, base pinned; ~2.5 px top bend at 1x. Randomise start frame + speed_scale (0.85-1.15) per instance

crop_glint.anchor: bottom-centre = south tip of the crop cell (same canvas + anchor as the crop props); draw just above the ripe crop
crop_glint.note: gatherable marker for *_ripe crops: soft warm sparkles (#fff0c8 / honey) twinkling over the crop plus a faint warm ground halo; painted, no neon. Desync per cell (random start frame). Hide when the crop is harvested

harvest_pop_cabbage.anchor: bottom-centre = south tip of the gathered cell (frame is 64 px (2x) taller than the crop canvas so the item can rise)
harvest_pop_cabbage.note: one-shot on gather: leaf burst + dust puff from the plant, the cabbage pickup icon (44 px@2x) rises ~88 px@2x and fades by frame 8. Swap cabbage_ripe -> cabbage_harvested on frame 0; give the item to the bag when the strip ends
